title: Quantity registry
description: Every registered quantity and the estimator ladder built for it, from reward_lens.core.quantity.QUANTITIES after load_quantities(). Generated by scripts/build_catalogue.py. `open` is true where a quantity is registered and nobody has built an estimator for it, which section 4.2 of the specification calls an open research target rather than a bug. The site names them, the same way the library's own documentation build does.

estimators.description: Registered estimators visible to THIS build. A thinner environment sees fewer, so this is never rendered as a property of the library without that scope attached.

id.description: A dotted internal address. Banned from prose, permitted here and on the registry route.

invariance.description: INVARIANT, COVARIANT or RAW_ONLY. A COVARIANT quantity compared across frames without a shared basis is a GAUGE_MISMATCH refusal, so this is the field a comparison interface must read before offering the comparison.

open.description: True when the ladder is empty. Must agree with `estimators` being empty; a true here beside a populated ladder is a generator defect.

provenance.description: Which library this was read from. A libraryVersion below 3.0.0 means the generator ran under the wrong venv and every count is a v2 count; build_catalogue.py refuses that case rather than emitting it. skippedModules names the modules a missing optional extra kept out of the walk, and it is not decoration: an estimator registers when its module imports, so a skipped module makes its quantities read as open. A reader who is told which extras were missing can tell 'nobody has built this' from 'this build could not see it'.
